links.outcome: Discharge summary edit time before and after AI hospital course tool, and by tool use
links.effect: No overall change between periods (6.60 vs 6.28 min, p=0.11); edit time longer with AI use (9.20 vs 4.93 min, p<0.001); adjusted 32% increase (95% CI 24%-41%).
links.quote: Among 2,206 encounters in the Post-AI period, edit time was longer when the AI tool was used (9.20 [IQR 4.9-16.3] vs 4.93 [IQR 2.5-9.7] minutes, p<0.001).

screen.reason: Empirical pre-post evaluation of the clinical implementation of a GPT-4-powered discharge summary hospital course generator on documentation time, quality, and clinician perceptions.
